newsitem.title: USA: Quaker Oats says bagged cereals profitable.
newsitem.headline: Quaker Oats says bagged cereals profitable.

text.p: Quaker Oats Co said its bagged cereal business, which posted 90 percent volume growth in the second quarter, is profitable, despite spending to further build the business.
"Bagged cereal is profitalble," Quaker Chairman William Smithburg said in an inteview.
Some analysts have said the bagged cereals, which carry the Quaker brand and a $1.99 pricetag, are not profitable.
Smithburg said Quaker has invested "sizeable" advertising and marketing amounts behind bagged cereals and in distribution.
"So, yes, we are spending money, and are spending to build volume," Smithburg said.
